casp13_gdt.notes: Senior et al. 2019 'Protein structure prediction using multiple deep neural networks in CASP13', Proteins 87(12) prot.25834 (companion to AlphaFold-v1 Nature 2020 s41586-019-1923-7). AlphaFold (group A7D, DeepMind) achieved median GDT_TS = 58.9 on CASP13 free-modeling (FM) domains — first place, ahead of 52.5 and 52.4 by the two next best-placed teams. Overall median GDT_TS across all CASP13 targets was 68.5 (not used here; this benchmark is FM-only). Cross-confirmed by Wikipedia AlphaFold article and DeepMind CASP13 retrospective.

casp14_gdt.notes: DeepMind official CASP14 announcement blog (Nov 30 2020): 'In the results from the 14th CASP assessment, released today, our latest AlphaFold system achieves a median score of 92.4 GDT overall across all targets.' Median GDT_TS across all CASP14 targets, AlphaFold2 group 427. Also reported in companion Nature paper s41586-021-03819-2 (Jumper et al. 2021).

casp15_gdt.notes: Liu et al. 2023 'Improving AlphaFold2-based protein tertiary structure prediction with MULTICOM in CASP15', Communications Chemistry s42004-023-00991-6 (also PMC10484931). Reports the standard AlphaFold2 predictor achieved average GDT-TS ~0.73 on 94 CASP15 domains — i.e. 73.0% on the GDT_TS [0,100] scale used in this DB. The MULTICOM_refine variant (top-3 server in CASP15) reached ~0.80 avg GDT-TS on the same 94-domain set, 9.6% improvement over standard AlphaFold2. CASP15 was substantially harder than CASP14 (more targets with novel folds / scarce MSAs), explaining the drop from 92.4 (CASP14) → 73.0 (CASP15) for the same model class.
